meta.homeDescription: Kirkiri ingantattun hotunan App Store da aka shirya don mika su, sannan yi amfani da Ollama don samar da sigogi na harsuna daban-daban cikin sauƙi.

features.titleHtml:
Kashe ƙaramin lokaci wajen shiri.
Fitar da shi cikin ƙarin kwarin gwiwa.
features.description: Screenshot (App) Maker yana mayar da ayyukan maimaita wa a ƙarshen fitar da manhaja zuwa wani abu guda ɗaya mai bayyanuwa kuma mai hoto.

cards.title: Shigar da hotunan fuskar manhajarka.
cards.body: Shigo da screenshots, sanya su a cikin tsarin na'urori masu kyau, sannan ka shirya cikakken labarin App Store cikin mintuna.

cards.title: Tsara sau ɗaya.
cards.body: Saka launuka, layouts, saitunan na'ura, nau'in rubutu, da inuwa a kowane shafi yayin da kake kiyaye kowace saƙo ta yadda take.

cards.title: Ya dace da kowane screen.
cards.body: Shirya assets na iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, da hotunan siffa daga aikin guda ɗaya.

cards.title: Fitar da package wanda aka shirya don mika shi.
cards.body: Haɗa hotuna masu inganci, tsara fayyilan da aka fassara zuwa harshen yanki, sannan ka haɗa bayanan App Store metadata da aka fassara zuwa cikin archive guda ɗaya mai tsafta.

localization.pill: Yana aiki ta hanyar server ɗinka na Ollama
localization.title: Kamfenin hotunan allonku (screenshot), ya shirya don kowane kasuwa.
localization.description: Haɗa Screenshot (App) Maker da Ollama sannan ka fassara kanun labaran hotunan allonku da kuma bayanan App Store a cikin tsarin aiki ɗaya. Tsarin asali zai tsaya yadda yake yayin da rubutun zai canza ga kowane harshe.
checks: Fassara dukkan kanun labaran hotunan allonku a matsayin batch
Fassarar bayanan, kalmomin bincike (keywords), da bayanan fitarwa (release notes)
Duba fassarorin kafin a fitar da su na ƙarshe
localization.completeBody: Rubutu da metadata sun shirya don duba su

ollama.title: Jagorar Saita Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Haɗa Screenshot (App) Maker da samfurin Ollama ɗinka don fassarar AI da samar da rubutu.
requirements: Na'urar Mac, Windows PC, ko Linux don gudanar da Ollama
An sanya Ollama kuma tana aiki
iPhone/iPad ɗinka a kan network ɗaya da na'urar Ollama (da ake ba da shawarar hakan)
steps: Shigar da Ollama: sauke sannan ka shigar da Ollama don OS ɗinka.
Fara Ollama: gudanar da ollama serve (ko buɗe manhajar Ollama a macOS).
Jawo samfuri: gudanar da ollama pull llama3.2 (ko samfurin da kake so).
Tabbatar cewa yana aiki: gudanar da ollama run llama3.2 sannan ka gwada prompt.
Nemo adireshin sabarka: rubuta LAN IP na kwamfutarka (misali 192.168.0.10).
Yi amfani da shi a cikin manhajar: a cikin saitunan Screenshot (App) Maker, sanya Host zuwa http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
notes: Idan manhajar ba ta iya haɗewa ba, tabbatar cewa wayarka da kwamfutarka suna kan hanyar sadarwar Wi‑Fi ɗaya.
Tabbatar cewa an ba wa port 11434 damar shiga ta hanyar firewall ɗinka.
Idan ka fi son amfani da remote server (PC na gida, VPS), dole ne ka buɗe port ɗin ta hanyar tsaro (ana ba da shawarar VPN).
ollama.ctaBody: Koma cikin manhajar, gwada haɗin, sannan ka fara da locale ɗaya.

privacy.title: Manufofin Sirri
privacy.intro: Wannan Manufofin Sirrin yana bayyana yadda Screenshot (App) Maker ("manhajar") yake sarrafa bayanan mai amfani.
summary: Babu asusu. Babu nazari. Babu bin diddigi.
Faillolinka da gyare-gyarenka suna nan a na'urarka sai dai idan ka zaɓi haɗawa da server na Ollama naka.
Idan kana amfani da Ollama, ana aika rubutu ne kawai zuwa adireshin server wanda ka saita.

sections.title: Tattara Bayanai
body: Manhajar ba ta tattara, ajiye, ko tura bayanan sirri zuwa server-dinmu.
Ana ƙirƙira da adana screenshots, templates, da hotuna da aka fitar a cikin na'urarka.

sections.title: Samun Damar Shiga Fayiloli da Hotuna
body: Manhajar na iya neman damar shiga manhajar Fayiloli ko rumbun hotunanka don shigo da screenshots.
Ana sarrafa hotunan da aka shigo a cikin na'urar, kuma ba a ɗora su ta atomatik ba.

sections.title: Fassarar AI (Ollama)
body: Idan ka kunna samar da rubutu ko fassarar AI, Manhajar na iya aiko rubutu zuwa sabar Ollama wadda ka tsara (misali, kwamfutarka).
Ba mu ne muke sarrafa ko karɓar zirga-zirgar Ollama ɗinka ba, kuma Manhajar ba ta yin rajista ko adana rubutun da AI ya sarrafa ba.

sections.title: Ayyukan ɓangare na uku
body: Manhajar ba ta amfani da nazarin ɓangare na uku, SDKs na talla, ko fasahohin bin diddigi.

sections.title: Canje-canje
body: Za mu iya sabunta wannan Manufar Sirri daga lokaci zuwa lokaci. Za a nuna canje-canjen a wannan shafin.

sections.title: Tuntuɓa
body: Idan kuna da tambayoyi game da wannan Manufar Sirrin Bayanai, da fatan za ku tuntuɓe mu ta adireshin imel da aka bayar a jere-jeren App Store.
